nodes.label: Client-Managed Quiz Fetching
nodes.rationale: The page performs no server prefetch because the client fetches quizzes after automatic language synchronization.

nodes.label: Hybrid Quiz Pagination
nodes.rationale: The public quiz tab uses server pagination, while My Quiz and Favorites filter local collections client-side; both modes feed the same pagination UI.

nodes.label: Single-Project Supabase Architecture
nodes.rationale: The tutorial deliberately simplifies the original two-project architecture into one Supabase source of truth for clarity and immediate operation.

nodes.label: Minimal Supabase Auth Design
nodes.rationale: The tutorial replaces AuthContext, middleware token refresh, and cross-tab synchronization with a minimal functional flow for faster setup.

nodes.label: Pending Redirect Preservation
nodes.rationale: The original flow stores pendingRedirect in sessionStorage so a user joining a room can return to that room after login.

nodes.label: Two-Project Supabase Setup
nodes.rationale: The setup overview defines two projects so auth, quiz, and backup operations can be separated from high-frequency player and Realtime updates to reduce rate-limit pressure.

nodes.label: Release-Speed Build Policy
nodes.rationale: The original project disables ESLint and TypeScript build failures to prioritize release speed; local tsc should remain active in the editor.

nodes.label: Memory Card Asset Optimization
nodes.rationale: Small WebP images are recommended because memory cards are rendered repeatedly in a matrix; smaller files help preserve 60fps flip animation.

nodes.label: Component Placement Policy
nodes.rationale: A component used by more than one page belongs in the shared components tree; a single-page component stays in that route's local components folder to keep the shared tree clean.

nodes.label: Single Supabase Project
nodes.rationale: The minimal version consolidates sessions, players, and quizzes into one Supabase project to run without the original split-project configuration.

nodes.label: Placeholder Anti-Crash Strategy
nodes.rationale: Placeholder URL and key values let the application build and render an error state rather than crash when environment variables are absent.

nodes.label: CSS-First Tailwind v4
nodes.rationale: Tailwind CSS v4 moved configuration into CSS and no longer needs tailwind.config.js, manual content arrays, or autoprefixer.
